name: sanctions-screening-mcp-server
description: Screen names against eleven OFAC, EU, UK, UN, BIS, and State sanctions and export-control lists and resolve legal entities against GLEIF, matched offline over a local SQLite + FTS5 mirror. A screening aid, not a compliance determination.
